train_nougat_model: train a Nougat model using a config file with --config and optional --exp_version flags
save_checkpoint_custom: save a PyTorch checkpoint to a specified path using CustomCheckpointIO save_checkpoint method
load_checkpoint_custom: load a checkpoint from a file or directory path using CustomCheckpointIO load_checkpoint method
